description: Cells of different tables that are the same element (for the rule: an optional can't come from a row that has the same element as a compulsory): Base age groups with each other, Base with the Cto. España table of the same age, Base Cadete with the FIG Age Group 11-16 tables (across catalogs), Cto. España Alevín with Cto. España Infantil, and Cto. España Infantil with 11-16. Reviewed by the coach on 2026-11-03, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-13; some pairs aren't identical pictures but count as the same element (e.g. Alevín Parejas ROW III C / Infantil ROW III A, legs together; Base Cadete Tríos ROW I A / 11-16 ROW I Box 2). A cell with two figures ('OR') can match two cells.
